newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Confirmed - None.
There were 128,600 head confirmed for week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was $64.00 per cwt on Wednesday.
Thursday's packer bids were $64.00, with asking prices $65.00-$66.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
